subject: ClearStream — demo coordination & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Michael Hughes <michael.hughes@clearstream.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearstream.com, ops-contacts@clearstream.com
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearStream — demo coordination & procurement checklist

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the intro. We’re close to a decision window and want a hands-on demo focused on:
- Private deployment options (VPC + on-prem connectors)
- Data handling and key management (KMS/HSM)
- Typical latency and throughput numbers for our payloads (avg 2k tok/session)

Proposed times: next Tues/Wed between 10–12 PT. SE and procurement will both join. Can you confirm availability and any pre-demo artifacts procurement needs?

Also copying ops in case we need network/port details ahead of time.

Regards,
Michael Hughes
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearStream Logistics

Hi Michael — great to hear.

We can run the session next week and will cover the private deployment flow and KMS/HSM integration. Diego (SE) will lead the live portion; I’ll run the agenda and Priya (contracts) will flag procurement asks at the top.

For procurement: Priya, can you confirm the minimal docs we should send ahead (SLA, SOC2, data retention, standard MSA)? Michael — if procurement has an existing SOW template, happy to map to it.

Proposed slot: Tue 2027-03-30 10:30–11:30 PT. If that works for all, I’ll send invites and a short pre-read (demo brief + network checklist).

Thanks,

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Hughes <michael.hughes@clearstream.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearStream — demo coordination & procurement checklist

Heads up — operations just flagged an unplanned maintenance window that affects a subset of our US-West private-hosted nodes (impact: live private-VPC demo that requires tenant boot in us-west).

What this means for tomorrow’s plan:
- I cannot guarantee a full end-to-end private cluster bring-up in us-west during the slot.
- Hosted API and dedicated reserved pools are unaffected — I can demo those live.
- Alternatives I can offer for the private/VPC portion:
  1) Run a recorded end-to-end private VPC demo (walkthrough + Q&A) and then do a focused live validation with your network team once maintenance clears (fast follow).
  2) Do a hybrid: live walkthrough of config + a small isolated sandbox live attach that demonstrates KMS calls (does not require full tenant boot).
  3) Move the full private VPC demo to Thu 2027-04-01 when maintenance is scheduled to be finished — but I know your decision timeline is tight.

If the customer wants to see latency for their 2k-token workload we can run sample throughput numbers against our dedicated pool and show realistic token/sec and p95 numbers. I can prepare that as a short appendix to the demo.

Rachel — recommend sending the alternatives to Michael and offer option #2 as the default (fastest to show core capabilities). Priya/Marissa — please note: if we commit to Thu 4/1 for a full private demo, we should pre-clear a light canary tenant to avoid last-minute failures.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearStream — demo coordination & procurement checklist

Thanks for the quick update, Diego — appreciate the options. Michael / ops team — short update and two asks:

1) Option selection (pick one):
   • Option A: Hybrid live (default) — live config walkthrough + KMS sandbox attach, sample latency/throughput from dedicated pool, followed by fast follow for full private bring-up once maintenance clears. (~60 minutes)
   • Option B: Full private demo on Thu 2027-04-01 — full tenant boot and end-to-end test (requires procurement sign-off and network pre-clear). (~75 minutes)

2) Procurement / network ask: if you pick Option B, can procurement share any SOW or legal templates by EOD Tue so Priya can start redlines? For Option A we only need a short network checklist (ports/IP ranges) — ops team can forward that.

Proposed confirmed slot for Option A: Tue 2027-03-30 10:30–11:30 PT (as originally proposed). If you prefer Option B, let us know and we’ll tentatively pencil Thu 4/1 11:00–12:15 PT.

I’ll attach the network checklist and high-level architecture (attached: proposed-amp-arch.drawio) and a short demo brief.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
